name: HydraDB Graph Database on Object Storage
idSeed: HydraDB v0.3 Graph Database on Object Storage
description: Cypher graph database that keeps its data in S3-compatible object storage.

HYDRADB_ROLE.description: Program this service runs: node = graph-node (Bolt 7687, HTTP query API 8443, admin 9090).

PORT.description: Admin port. Railway's healthcheck GETs /readyz here; ready once the Bucket passes the write probe.

HYDRADB_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for the HTTP API and the Bolt password (any user name). 32+ chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ ~ -.

CLOUD_PROVIDER.description: Object store type read by SlateDB. aws = any S3-compatible store, here the Railway Bucket.

AWS_BUCKET_NAME.description: Bucket that holds the graph (records, WALs, leases, indexes). The source of truth for all data.

AWS_REGION.description: Bucket region used to sign S3 requests.

HYDRADB_S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3 endpoint without the bucket name. The start script derives AWS_ENDPOINT from it.

HYDRADB_S3_ADDRESSING.description: virtual = https://{bucket}.{endpoint host} (new Railway Buckets); path for older buckets (see Credentials tab).

GRAPH_NAMESPACE.description: Namespace of the graph. With 'default' the X-Graph-Namespace HTTP header is optional.

GRAPH_ID.description: Graph id, used in the HTTP path /v1/graphs/{id}/query.

GRAPH_DATABASE.description: Bolt database name: pass it as the session database in Neo4j drivers.

GRAPH_CELL_ID.description: Partition (cell) this node owns. Every HTTP query must send it as cell_id.

GRAPH_CELLS.description: All cells of the graph, comma-separated. Must contain GRAPH_CELL_ID.

GRAPH_DATA_PATH.description: Prefix inside the Bucket for all HydraDB objects. Do not change after the first write.

GRAPH_NODE_ID.description: Stable node id used for heartbeats, writer leases and Bolt routing tables.

GRAPH_ADVERTISED_BOLT_ADDR.description: Bolt address this node puts in routing tables (neo4j:// URIs). Private network by default.

GRAPH_INDEXER_NOTIFY_URL.description: Wakes the indexer after writes (sent with the bearer token). Empty = the indexer only polls.

HYDRADB_TLS.description: off = plaintext behind Railway's HTTPS edge. self-signed = TLS on Bolt and HTTP (breaks the public domain).

GRAPH_DATA_CACHE_BYTES.description: SlateDB disk cache on the volume. auto = 75% of the volume, 64 MiB to 8 GiB; or a number of bytes.

GRAPH_SLATE_DB_CACHE_BYTES.description: SlateDB RAM cache. auto = 5/16 of the memory budget, 64 MiB to 2 GiB; or bytes (0 disables it).

GRAPH_MAX_GRAPHBLAS_BYTES.description: Memory for compiled GraphBLAS matrices. auto = 1/16 of the memory budget, 32 to 512 MiB; or bytes.

HYDRADB_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB.description: Memory budget for the auto sizes. auto = the container limit (2 GiB if none is visible); or MiB.

HYDRADB_CPU_LIMIT.description: Cores for thread pools. auto = the container CPU quota (else nproc), capped at 8; or a number.

GRAPHBLAS_NTHREADS.description: SuiteSparse GraphBLAS threads. auto = HYDRADB_CPU_LIMIT's core count.

TOKIO_WORKER_THREADS.description: Async runtime worker threads. auto = the core count, at least 2.

HYDRADB_CACHE_RESET.description: true empties the disk cache at every start. Use once after emptying or replacing the Bucket's data.

GRAPH_CYPHER_ENGINE.description: legacy = the documented OpenCypher subset. experimental = upstream's newer engine (not for production).

RUST_LOG.description: Log filter (JSON logs). e.g. info,hydradb=debug for more detail.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL, so the node drains queries and hands back its writer lease.

HYDRADB_HOST.description: Private host name for clients that take host and port separately.

HYDRADB_URL.description: HTTP query API base URL on the private network. Reference it as ${{HydraDB.HYDRADB_URL}}.

HYDRADB_QUERY_URL.description: POST endpoint for queries (JSON body with cell_id and query; bearer token).

HYDRADB_BOLT_URL.description: Bolt URL for Neo4j drivers on the private network.

HYDRADB_PUBLIC_URL.description: HTTPS query API on the public domain (token required). Egress-billed; prefer the private URL.

HYDRADB_METRICS_URL.description: Prometheus scrape URL on the private network (no auth, never public).

NEO4J_URI.description: Same as HYDRADB_BOLT_URL, under the name Neo4j-driver apps usually read.

NEO4J_USERNAME.description: Bolt user name. HydraDB ignores it; any value works.

HYDRADB_ROLE.description: Program this service runs: indexer = graph-indexer (builds traversal indexes; admin 9091).

PORT.description: Indexer admin port. Railway's healthcheck GETs /readyz here.

HYDRADB_AUTH_TOKEN.description: The node's token. The indexer accepts change notifications only with it.

CLOUD_PROVIDER.description: Same object store as the node.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Same bucket access key as the node.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Same bucket secret key as the node.

HYDRADB_S3_ENDPOINT.description: Same S3 endpoint as the node.

HYDRADB_S3_ADDRESSING.description: Same addressing style as the node.

GRAPH_ID.description: Same graph id as the node.

GRAPH_DATA_PATH.description: Same data prefix as the node.

GRAPH_INDEXER_BUILD_MODE.description: full rebuilds each index generation (upstream default); incremental reuses the previous one.

GRAPH_INDEXER_INTERVAL_MS.description: Full sweep interval over all graph scopes (upstream default).

GRAPH_INDEXER_DIRTY_POLL_INTERVAL_MS.description: Poll for changed graphs (50-60000). 1000 instead of upstream's 250: the node already wakes the indexer.

GRAPH_INDEXER_RETAIN_PREVIOUS.description: Older index generations kept in the Bucket for readers still using them.

GRAPH_SLATE_DB_CACHE_BYTES.description: SlateDB RAM cache. auto = 5/16 of the memory budget, 64 MiB to 2 GiB; or bytes.

HYDRADB_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB.description: Memory budget for the auto sizes. auto = the container limit (2 GiB if none is visible); or MiB.

HYDRADB_CPU_LIMIT.description: Cores for thread pools. auto = the container CPU quota (else nproc), capped at 8; or a number.

GRAPHBLAS_NTHREADS.description: SuiteSparse GraphBLAS threads. auto = HYDRADB_CPU_LIMIT's core count.

TOKIO_WORKER_THREADS.description: Async runtime worker threads. auto = the core count, at least 2.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL, so an index build can stop cleanly.
